title: E5: Run tests and quality gates
description: Run: go fmt ./... && go vet ./... && go test ./... && go build -o aqe ./cmd/aqe. All must pass with zero errors and zero vet warnings. If any unit tests reference the old Docling HTTP client or old chunker interface, update them to reflect the new Processor-based architecture. Acceptance: clean build, all tests green.

title: E4: Validate extractions and exports
description: Run extractions: './aqe extract "history of computing and early computers"' and './aqe extract "algorithms and computational thinking" --max-quotes 5 --min-relevance 80'. Run exports: './aqe export 1 --format markdown', './aqe export 1 --format json', './aqe export 1 --format bibtex'. Verify: (1) quotes are more substantive — paragraph-length, coherent passages, (2) Harvard in-text citations are correct format (Author, Year, p. N), (3) JSON export is valid (pipe through python3 -m json.tool), (4) adjacent context was used during scoring but does not appear in displayed quote text, (5) relevance scores are reasonable (60-100 range). Acceptance: extraction quality is visibly improved vs previous granular chunks.

title: E3: Re-ingest all documents via local pipeline
description: Run './aqe ingest --debug input/' to re-ingest all 3 test PDFs via the new local Python pipeline. Verify via debug output: (1) process_document.py is called (not HTTP Docling), (2) HybridChunker is used with max_tokens=800 (look for debug messages), (3) total chunk count is ~2,000-4,000 (down from 16,660), (4) chunks have section paths and position values populated, (5) Weaviate embeddings are generated for all chunks. Set document metadata (authors, year, publisher) via aqe meta fix for proper Harvard citations. Acceptance: all 3 documents ingested with well-formed chunks.

title: E2: Stop and remove Docker Docling container
description: Run 'docker stop docling && docker rm docling' to remove the Docling container. Verify with 'docker ps' that only Weaviate and Ollama are running. Optionally run 'docker image prune' to reclaim the ~8GB docling-serve image. Acceptance: Docling container is gone, Weaviate and Ollama still running and healthy.

title: E1: Wipe database and Weaviate
description: Delete quotes.db to remove all old chunk IDs, extractions, and quotes. The Weaviate Chunk class will be recreated automatically on next ingest (via CreateSchema). This is a breaking change for any existing data — old chunk ID formats and missing position values make migration impractical. Acceptance: clean slate with no leftover data.

title: C4: Remove Docling from docker-compose.yml
description: File: docker-compose.yml. Remove the entire 'docling' service block (image, container_name, ports, deploy resources, environment, healthcheck, restart). Update any file-level comments that reference Docling as a Docker service. Keep Weaviate and Ollama services unchanged. Acceptance: 'docker-compose up -d' starts only Weaviate and Ollama.

title: C2: Refactor ingest.go to use Processor
description: File: internal/cli/ingest.go. Remove docling.NewClient() HTTP client init (line ~72). Remove docling Health() check (line ~78). Remove separate chunker.NewChunker() init (line ~112). Replace with single docling.NewProcessor() init. Update processFile() signature to accept *docling.Processor instead of *docling.Client + *chunker.Chunker. In processFile: replace doclingClient.ConvertFile() + separate chunking with processor.ProcessFile() which returns chunks directly. Convert []chunker.ChunkOutput to []*models.Chunk with position set. Keep textItemsToChunks() as emergency fallback marked as legacy. Update error messages to reference Python instead of Docker Docling.

title: C1: Create Go subprocess wrapper (processor.go)
description: New file: internal/docling/processor.go. New type Processor struct holding pythonPath, scriptPath, maxTokens, overlapTokens, debug fields. Constructor: NewProcessor(scriptPath string, opts ...ProcessorOption) (*Processor, error) — finds python3 via exec.LookPath, verifies script exists. Options: WithMaxTokens(n int), WithOverlap(n int), WithDebug(bool). Method: ProcessFile(ctx context.Context, filePath string) ([]chunker.ChunkOutput, error) — runs 'python3 scripts/process_document.py --file <path> --max-tokens N --overlap N [--debug]', reads JSON lines from stdout into []chunker.ChunkOutput. Stderr is captured and logged when debug=true. Acceptance: processor.ProcessFile(ctx, 'input/book.pdf') returns chunks without Docker.

title: B3: Update scripts/requirements.txt
description: File: scripts/requirements.txt. Update to include all dependencies for HybridChunker and local Docling parsing: docling>=2.70.0, docling-core[chunking]>=2.0.0, transformers, sentencepiece. The [chunking] extra for docling-core is required for HybridChunker and HuggingFaceTokenizer. Acceptance: pip install -r scripts/requirements.txt on a clean venv installs everything needed for process_document.py.

title: B2: Create scripts/process_document.py entry point
description: New file: scripts/process_document.py. CLI args via argparse: --file PATH (required for stage=all/parse), --max-tokens INT (default 800), --overlap INT (default 200), --stage {all,parse,chunk} (default all), --debug. Stage 'all': parse file via lib.parser, chunk via lib.chunker, output JSON lines via lib.output to stdout. Stage 'parse': parse file, output DoclingDocument JSON to stdout (for debugging parsing issues). Stage 'chunk': read DoclingDocument JSON from stdin, chunk and output JSON lines (for debugging chunking issues). --debug: emit progress messages to stderr. Output format: one JSON object per line with keys id, text, page_num, section_path, bbox.

title: B1: Create scripts/lib/ module structure
description: Create scripts/lib/__init__.py (empty), scripts/lib/parser.py, scripts/lib/chunker.py, scripts/lib/output.py. parser.py: parse_document(file_path: str) -> DoclingDocument wrapping DocumentConverter().convert(). chunker.py: create_chunker(max_tokens) returning HybridChunker with HuggingFaceTokenizer(sentence-transformers/all-MiniLM-L6-v2); chunk_document(doc, max_tokens, overlap_tokens) -> list[ChunkData]; add_overlap(chunks, overlap_tokens, tokenizer) post-processing overlap by prepending tail of previous chunk and appending head of next chunk with ' [...] ' separator. output.py: extract_page_number, extract_section_path, extract_bbox helpers plus format_chunk(chunk_data, index) -> dict for JSON-line output. Each module independently importable and testable.

title: A4: Set position on chunks during ingest
description: File: internal/cli/ingest.go. In textItemsToChunks(): set chunk.Position = i (the loop index). In chunkOutputsToChunks(): set chunk.Position = i (the loop index). Acceptance: all chunks created during ingestion have a sequential position (0-based) per document, matching their order in the source document.

title: A3: Update InsertChunk/InsertChunks to include position
description: File: internal/store/sqlite.go. Update InsertChunk SQL to include the position column in INSERT. Update InsertChunks batch insert SQL to include position. Acceptance: position value is persisted to SQLite on every chunk insert.

title: A2: Add Position field to Chunk model
description: File: internal/models/chunk.go. Add 'Position int' field with db:"position" tag to the Chunk struct. Place it after the EmbeddingID field. Acceptance: Position is settable and readable on all Chunk instances, zero value (0) is the default.

title: A1: Add position column to chunks table
description: File: internal/store/migrations.go. Add 'position INTEGER' column to chunks table DDL. Add composite index: CREATE INDEX idx_chunks_doc_position ON chunks(document_id, position). Add migration path: detect whether position column exists via PRAGMA table_info(chunks); if missing, ALTER TABLE chunks ADD COLUMN position INTEGER DEFAULT 0 and create the index. Acceptance: existing databases gain the column via migration, new databases have it from creation.

title: A0: Amend constitution Principle V
description: Update .specify/memory/constitution.md Principle V. Change 'Docling-serve MUST run as a Docker container' to 'Docling MUST be invoked as a local Python subprocess via scripts/'. Keep Docker requirement for Weaviate and Ollama. Bump version 1.0.0 to 1.1.0. Update Last Amended date. Rationale: Docling is a batch converter called only during ingestion, not a persistent service. Local Python uses 1.8GB vs 16GB Docker allocation.

title: Phase E: Re-ingest, Validate, Update Docs
description: Wipe database and Weaviate. Stop and remove Docker Docling. Re-ingest all 3 test PDFs via the new local Python pipeline. Validate extraction quality, Harvard citations, and export formats. Run all tests. Update all documentation (README, quickstarts, AGENTS.md, STATUS.md, CLI_REFERENCE) to reflect the new architecture.

title: Phase C: Go Integration (local Docling)
description: Replace Docling HTTP client with Go subprocess wrapper that calls scripts/process_document.py. Refactor ingest.go to use new Processor type. Update status command to check Python/docling availability instead of HTTP health. Remove Docling from docker-compose.yml. Mark old HTTP client as deprecated.

title: Phase B: Python Pipeline (parse + chunk)
description: Create modular Python pipeline that combines document parsing (local Docling) and chunking (HybridChunker with 800-token limit and 200-token overlap) into a single subprocess call. Replaces Docker docling-serve HTTP API and the separate chunk_helper.py script. Structure: scripts/process_document.py entry point with scripts/lib/ modules for parser, chunker, and output. Supports --stage flag for debugging individual stages.

title: Phase A: Constitution + Schema + Models
description: Amend constitution Principle V to allow local Python Docling. Add position column to chunks table for adjacency queries. Update Chunk model with Position field. Add GetAdjacentChunks store method. Update insert methods. No breaking changes to existing runtime flow.

title: E6: Update all documentation
description: Update these files to reflect the new architecture: (1) README.md — remove Docker Docling references, add Python/pip requirement, update architecture overview; (2) USERS_QUICKSTART.md — remove docker-compose for Docling, add pip install step, update aqe status output example; (3) DEV_QUICKSTART.md — update prerequisites, remove Docling Docker, add Python dev setup; (4) AGENTS.md — update Docker Services section, add process_document.py reference, update file references; (5) STATUS.md — update with new chunk characteristics, note local Docling change; (6) CLI_REFERENCE.md — document --candidates flag, update aqe status output. Acceptance: no documentation references Docker Docling or localhost:5001.

title: D4: Wire adjacent chunk fetching into extract
description: File: internal/cli/extract.go. After weaviateClient.HybridSearch() returns candidate results, for each candidate: (1) call store.GetAdjacentChunks(chunkID, 1) to get prev and next chunks, (2) truncate adjacent chunk text to ~800 characters (~200 tokens) to keep prompt size manageable, (3) populate PrevContext and NextContext on the ChunkInput. This adds one SQLite query per candidate — with 100 candidates that is fast against SQLite. Acceptance: Claude's prompt includes surrounding context for each candidate. The context text does NOT appear in the displayed quote output — only in the scoring prompt.

title: D3: Add --candidates CLI flag to extract
description: File: internal/cli/extract.go. Add new flag: --candidates (int, default 100). Replace hardcoded candidateLimit logic (currently: 50, or maxQuotes*2 if maxQuotes>25) with: candidateLimit = candidatesFlag; if candidateLimit < maxQuotes*2 then candidateLimit = maxQuotes*2. Adjust Claude timeout to scale with candidate count: timeout := 120*time.Second + time.Duration(candidateLimit/10)*time.Second. Acceptance: 'aqe extract topic --candidates 150' sends 150 candidates to Claude. Default 100 is 2x the previous 50.

title: D2: Update Claude prompt template with context
description: File: internal/claude/prompt.go. Update extractionPromptTemplate to conditionally show PrevContext and NextContext for each chunk using Go template conditionals. Add instruction in IMPORTANT RULES section: 'Previous/following context is provided for reference to help you understand the passage in context. Select chunks based on the main Text field. Do not treat context text as part of the quote.' Also update BuildPromptJSON variant for consistency. Acceptance: Claude sees surrounding context but understands only main Text is quotable.

title: D1: Add PrevContext/NextContext to ChunkInput
description: File: internal/claude/wrapper.go. Add two new fields to the ChunkInput struct: PrevContext string with json tag 'prev_context,omitempty' and NextContext string with json tag 'next_context,omitempty'. These carry truncated text from adjacent chunks to give Claude surrounding context during relevance scoring. Acceptance: ChunkInput can carry optional context strings; existing code that doesn't set them continues to work (omitempty).

title: C3: Update status command for local Docling
description: File: internal/cli/status.go. Remove the Docling HTTP health check that hits localhost:5001. Replace with a Python/docling availability check: run 'python3 -c "import docling; print(docling.__version__)"' and parse the output. Display: 'Docling [OK] python3 (docling 2.70.0)' on success, or 'Docling [FAIL] ...' with specific error (python3 not found, docling package not installed, wrong version). Keep Weaviate and Ollama health checks unchanged.

title: B4: Test Python pipeline standalone
description: Run process_document.py against each of the 3 test PDFs in input/ directory. Verify: (1) chunk count is significantly lower than previous 16,660 (expect ~2,000-4,000 total), (2) average token size per chunk is 600-1000 tokens accounting for overlap, (3) section paths are populated (non-empty arrays), (4) page numbers are present and reasonable, (5) overlap text with ' [...] ' separator is visible at chunk boundaries. Also test each --stage independently: --stage parse outputs valid JSON, --stage chunk reads that JSON and produces chunks. Test --debug outputs progress to stderr.

title: A5: Add GetAdjacentChunks store method
description: File: internal/store/sqlite.go. New method: GetAdjacentChunks(chunkID string, window int) ([]*Chunk, error). Implementation: first query the chunk's document_id and position, then query WHERE document_id = ? AND position BETWEEN pos-window AND pos+window ORDER BY position. Returns the target chunk plus its neighbors (up to 2*window+1 chunks total). Acceptance: given chunk at position 5 with window=1, returns chunks at positions 4, 5, 6 (if they exist). Returns only the target chunk if it has no neighbors.

title: Phase D: Adjacent Context + Candidate Ceiling
description: Add adjacent chunk context to Claude prompts so the LLM can see surrounding text when scoring relevance. Add --candidates CLI flag (default 100) to replace the hardcoded 50-candidate ceiling. Adjacent context is read-only in the prompt — Claude still selects individual chunk IDs, preserving the deterministic quote guarantee.

title: C5: Mark deprecated Docling HTTP code
description: File: internal/docling/client.go — add a package-level comment: 'Deprecated: This HTTP client was used with docling-serve in Docker. Use Processor in processor.go instead for local Python Docling.' File: scripts/chunk_helper.py — add a header comment: 'Deprecated: Replaced by process_document.py which combines parsing and chunking.' Do not delete either file — they may be useful for remote Docling setups. Acceptance: both files have clear deprecation notices, no dead imports in the rest of the codebase.
